chunks: Ismaʿīl ibn Muslim narrated from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “The best women of my nation are those with the brightest faces and the least dowry.”

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: best; most excellent in rank and virtue
key_terms.أُمَّتِي: my nation; the Muslim community of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.مَهْرًا: dowry; the bridal gift given at marriage
key_terms.نِسَاءِ: women; female members of the community
key_terms.وَجْهًا: face; here indicating brightness or pleasant appearance

ai.seo_question: What does the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about the best women of the Ummah and dowries?
ai.summary: This hadith praises women distinguished by pleasant countenance and modest dowries. It highlights ease and simplicity in marriage and presents these qualities as virtuous within the Muslim community.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4356 - Isma'il ibn Muslim narrated from al-Sadiq Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers (peace be upon them) that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"The best women of my nation are those with the most radiant faces and the lowest dowries."
